reasons.uss-design-slot: A brand overrides a component design slot. Projecting it needs a nested var() fallback (design slot, then token slot), which this projection does not emit; follow-up in P4.
reasons.uss-property: The CSS property has no USS counterpart (or only one this projection does not map); the declaration is not realised.
reasons.uss-pseudo: USS has no pseudo-class for this state (indeterminate).
reasons.uss-scalar: The value is not a supported USS scalar (composite shadow, cubic-bezier easing, calc(), em or other relative units, rem outside the typography projection, a keyword USS lacks, or a weight USS cannot express); it is not emitted.
reasons.uss-selector: The selector has no USS realisation: either the IR's native selector grammar refused the styles key (attribute selectors such as [aria-expanded] and web-template classes such as <part>--<state> are not contract state facts; promoting a11y-attribute selectors to IR state predicates is deferred to the IR-facts spec that follows P3), or the rule needs a negated state or a modifier class no Unity runtime sets.
